# Reins

> An execution layer for AI agents and bots trading Hyperliquid perpetuals. Position, leverage, daily-loss and per-trade risk limits are enforced outside the model, a stop-loss is required on every position, and every decision is written to an append-only log with the reason the agent gave. Paper trading (live prices, simulated fills, nothing signed) is the default. Reins is not an exchange and holds no funds or liquidity.

Install: `npx @r2rlabs/reins init` adds a paper-trading Reins server to `.mcp.json`. Nine MCP tools over stdio; `reins http` serves the same tools over HTTP for bots that do not speak MCP.

Cost: paper trading is free. Live trading on mainnet carries a 2 basis point Hyperliquid builder fee (capped by the exchange at 0.1% on perps), approved once by the account owner with `npx @r2rlabs/reins approve-builder`. There is no subscription, no account with Reins, and no custody of funds.

## What an agent gets

- Limits that refuse orders regardless of what the model decides: `POSITION_TOO_LARGE`, `LEVERAGE_TOO_HIGH`, `HALTED_DAILY_LOSS`, `TRADE_RISK_TOO_LARGE`, `NO_STOP_LOSS`, `SYMBOL_NOT_ALLOWED`, `RATE_LIMITED`, `INVALID_ORDER`.
- Tools: get_positions, get_limits, get_book, get_candles, place_order, set_stop_loss, cancel_order, close_position, get_decisions.
- HTTP endpoints for non-MCP bots: /health, /limits, /positions, /book, /candles, /decisions, /orders, /stops, /cancel, /close.
- An append-only decision log, one JSON line per action, including refusals and fills the exchange made on its own.

## Links

- [Source](https://github.com/R2Rlabs/reins): TypeScript, MIT licensed, runs locally.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@r2rlabs/reins): `@r2rlabs/reins`.
- [MCP Registry entry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=hyperliquid-reins): `io.github.R2Rlabs/hyperliquid-reins`.
- [A recorded run](https://gist.github.com/R2Rlabs/246a5009684787a586ddee1d2615eb14): an AI agent trading on paper for five days, 111 cycles, every trade and refusal listed.
- [Python client example](https://github.com/R2Rlabs/reins/blob/main/examples/bot.py): a dependency-free bot sizing its order from its stop.
